title: A Rigorous, Tractable Measure of Model Complexity
abstract: arXiv:2605.21167v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: An accurate assessment of a model's complexity is crucial for topics such as interpretation, generalization, and model selection. However, existing complexity measures either rely on heuristic assumptions or are computationally prohibitive. In this paper, we present a mathematically rigorous yet easy-to-compute measure of model complexity that is based on the similarities between feature vectors for different inputs. It is thus well-defined for any parametric model (via NTK feature generalization) and for kernel-based non-parametric models (via the induced kernel). We prove that our measure of complexity generalizes model-specific complexity measures, including polynomial degree (for polynomial regression), kernel length scale (for Mat\'ern kernels), number of neighbors (for k-nearest neighbors), number of splits (for decision trees), and number of trees (for random forests). translated_title: 一种严谨且易于计算的模型复杂度度量
translated_abstract: 准确评估模型的复杂度对于模型解释、泛化和模型选择等课题至关重要。然而，现有的复杂度度量方法要么依赖于启发式假设，要么计算代价过高。在本文中，我们提出了一种数学上严谨且易于计算的模型复杂度度量，该度量基于不同输入的特征向量之间的相似性。因此，它对任何参数化模型（通过NTK特征泛化）以及基于核的非参数模型（通过诱导核）都有良好的定义。我们证明了我们的复杂度度量可以泛化多种特定于模型的复杂度度量，包括多项式次数（对应多项式回归）、核长度尺度（对应Matérn核）、邻居数量（对应k近邻）、分裂次数（对应决策树）以及树的数量（对应随机森林）。我们还使用我们的度量获得了对……的新见解。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于特征向量相似性的、数学上严谨且易于计算的模型复杂度度量，它适用于参数化和核方法非参数化模型，并能统一泛化多种现有模型特定的复杂度度量（如多项式次数、k近邻邻居数、决策树分裂次数、随机森林树的数量等）。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a mathematically rigorous yet easy-to-compute measure of model complexity based on feature-vector similarities, which is well-defined for both parametric and kernel-based non-parametric models and generalizes existing model-specific complexity measures such as polynomial degree, number of neighbors, number of splits, and number of trees.
